mapper.sql: id, product_id, sku_code, spec_json, spec_key, price, market_price, cost_price, stock, image, status, sort, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.order_status NOT IN (1, 6) AND o.pay_at IS NOT NULL AND oi.sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sku (product_id, sku_code, spec_json, spec_key, price, market_price, cost_price, stock, image, status, sort, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{skuCode}, #{specJson}, #{specKey}, #{price}, #{marketPrice}, #{costPrice}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET sku_code = #{skuCode}, spec_json = #{specJson}, spec_key = #{specKey}, price = #{price}, market_price = #{marketPrice}, cost_price = #{costPrice}, stock = #{stock}, image = #{image}, status = #{status}, sort = #{sort}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product_sku SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product_sku SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId}

UPDATE products p SET p.stock = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0) FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 1), p.sales_price = COALESCE((SELECT MIN(s.price) FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 1), p.sales_price), p.market_price = COALESCE((SELECT s.market_price FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.price ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT 1), p.market_price), p.update_time = #{now} WHERE p.id = #{productId}
